reusable_observations.observation: A retrieved Design Episode can reduce repeated analysis yet a fixed turn budget may spend the savings on extra speculative candidates.
reusable_observations.action: Report both full-budget cost and cost to a predeclared valid-improvement threshold. Do not infer end-to-end speedup from an earlier first edit alone.

reusable_observations.observation: The model may continue searching after a correct candidate already clears a useful PPA threshold.
reusable_observations.action: Freeze an automatic stopping threshold before the run. Trigger it only after correctness, area and measured post-synthesis gates; always retain independent route and processor-regression finalization.

reusable_observations.observation: Target-specific memory measures reuse rather than blind discovery.
reusable_observations.action: Keep a separate cross-target memory arm with no current target root cause or transformation, and label target-memory results as an engineering upper bound.

reusable_observations.observation: Search wall time can be distorted by concurrent EDA work even when scheduler slots and memory limits are respected.
reusable_observations.action: Record concurrent jobs and active tool time. Prefer a serial paired run for wall-time causality; treat provider token, turn and EDA counts as less resource-sensitive metrics.

reusable_observations.observation: An index hit does not prove the Agent consumed the episode body.
reusable_observations.action: Audit search and retrieve separately. If the treatment requires memory use, make the body retrieval an explicit prerequisite while leaving section selection to the Agent.

measured_example_without_target_solution.group: generic process memory versus no memory
measured_example_without_target_solution.interpretation: The process memory accelerated arrival at a validated candidate, but fixed-budget continuation erased the wall-time gain.
